What a hotel night costs in 12 destinations, taxes and fees included: $105 in Paris to $303 in Los Angeles

The median price of a night with taxes and fees, from 198 hotels priced on every booking site, Sep 25 to 29, 2026: Paris $105, Fort Lauderdale $112, New Orleans $143, Orlando $145, New York $191, Las Vegas $196, Miami $225, Cancun $233, Chicago $276, London $277, Nashville $290, Los Angeles $303.

What hotels cost in 12 of the destinations travelers search most, from our price study: at the hotels Google Hotels returned for each city, the same two-night stay priced on every booking site it listed, on one date. Each guide gives the median all-in price by star class, how much taxes and fees added, how often a site was 5% or more below the going rate, which sites were lowest, free cancellation, and the hotels with the widest gaps between sites.

Each figure is dated: these are snapshots taken on September 25, 2026, September 28, 2026 and September 29, 2026, not today's prices, and a few dates cannot tell you a season or the time to book. Prices change daily.
